brief: A modern, high-volume retail supermarket point-of-sale terminal and inventory operating system. Needs a clean, friendly, and authoritative identity combining storefront charm and seamless checkout throughput.

concepts.name: Market Canopy
concepts.idea: An iconic scalloped supermarket storefront canopy fused with a rolling checkout cart.
rationale: Unmistakable grocery storefront heritage paired with modern checkout mobility.
Calibrated palette of Slate Gray (#1E293B) and Peach Fuzz (#FFBE98) for hardware authority and organic warmth.
Engineered for high readability from 16px desktop browser tabs to physical store signage.

recommendation: Market Canopy establishes a definitive supermarket identity that feels authentic to retail operations while standing out with contemporary warmth.
